verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM can run as a headless self-hosted server (Docker, with k8s health probes). It also exposes a documented developer API with an OpenAPI spec for programmatic management and chatting, so automation can drive it without the UI. However, nothing documents a CLI, a one-shot non-interactive run mode, or CI pipeline usage, so headless/CI automation is only implied via the server plus API. Missing for 10: an official CLI or non-interactive run mode, documented CI/pipeline usage guides, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: AnythingLLM supports a full developer API that you can use to manage, update, embed, and even chat with your workspaces
